Root cause: the new `/onboarding/wedding` flow drives its 15+ screens with pure React state (`go(d)`), so the on-screen "‹" worked but the **device hardware Back / browser Back / mobile swipe-back were never intercepted** — they popped the page out of onboarding to whatever loaded before it; for the dashboard→`create-event`→Wedding entry path that previous page was the legacy `/dashboard/create-event` event-type picker = the "old onboarding". Removed the per-page `<Nav>` (import+render) from all 12 pages (home/about/how-it-works/pricing/for-vendors/our-story/blog/realstories/features/explore/tl·about/tl·how-it-works). Core: sealing wax = thermoplastic (melt ~71–82°C), whole craft = hitting ONE viscosity window. Process: melt-slowly(don't overheat→bubbles) → pour runny puddle (self-levels into a bead, size=amount) → COOL ~10s to "soft but not runny" (the make-or-break) → chill/moisten stamp (anti-stick) → press STRAIGHT down firmly, NEVER twist (deboss field + emboss design + edge bulge) → hold 30s+ then lift straight/rock, never twist. THE refinement for our sim: a THREE-zone consistency window (too-liquid=smear/flow-back · soft-set=CRISP reward · too-hard=shallow/won't-take), not the 2-zone we had; plus ~10–20s timing, no-twist release smear, overheat→bubbles. Fix: (1) give the disc a TAPERED, rounded edge (smoothstep meniscus over the outer ~0.11 band) instead of a vertical cliff — also more physically correct (real wax has a meniscus); (2) ALPHA-TO-COVERAGE soft alpha at the edge (MSAA coverage) on top of supersampling → the thin tapered rim antialiases to a smooth curve. Build rule: never cut a cutout/discard mesh at a hard grid-rasterized boundary — taper it + use alphaToCoverage/supersample. Prototype: wax_creation_smooth_rim. | 0024_save_the_date/0024_ADDENDUM_envelope_open_experience_2026-06-14.md §3 |

Fix: the press now only DEFORMS EXISTING WAX (skip cells with no wax) — flattens the contact area into the blob + bulges displaced wax outward, so the seal stays ONE CONTINUOUS organic blob with the couple's drip outline (no disc, no slice); monogram embosses via the field bump. Added STAMP SIZE slider (rs ~0.24–0.56, default small) + the visual stamp mesh scales to match. Build rule: a seal press is a deformation of the existing wax body, never a circle drawn independent of it. | 2026-06-16 | Save-the-Date · PREVIEW STRATEGY settled (owner reasoning). Preview is PERSONALIZED (the couple's real monogram/names/date/palette/reveal), NOT a generic non-them sample — informed buyers convert more + refund less ("no this-isn't-what-I-expected"); a generic sample forces a leap of faith + under-sells. RISK = screen recording → REFRAME: you can't stop screen capture, so make the CAPTURE WORTHLESS, not impossible. Mitigation = centred SETNAYAN watermark (over design + video) + reduced resolution → a grab is a branded blurry thumbnail, not a sendable Save the Date. ⚠ CAUTION on "make it really small to maximize": over-correction — the preview's JOB is to SELL, so DON'T over-shrink; the WATERMARK is the lock, not tininess. Keep it GENEROUSLY VIEWABLE (big enough to fall in love with); protect via watermark + low-res, not size. Defense-in-depth extras: DEAD/placeholder QR in preview (no working RSVP link), no download/right-click, video-in-preview = short watermarked LOOP not the full film. Rule: personalized · centred watermark · lower-res · generously sized to seduce · dead QR · clean full version on UNLOCK. Refines the prior watermark-preview row. | 0024_save_the_date/0024_ADDENDUM_envelope_open_experience_2026-06-14.md §7 |
| 2026-06-16 | Save-the-Date · preview DOWNLOAD-protection = a 3-LAYER STACK (owner Q: "if they download the photo, the watermark is on top, so only the watermark downloads?"). YES that works (for <img>): a transparent WATERMARK OVERLAY on top → right-click "Save image" grabs the topmost image (the watermark), not the design beneath (stock-photo trick); the design rendered as DOM/CSS/SVG has no "save image" target at all. LIMITS (honest): the overlay does NOT stop SCREENSHOTS / screen-recording, and for the live reveal (a CANVAS) "save image" = canvas pixels → the watermark must be BAKED INTO the render, not overlaid. So layer it: (1) transparent watermark overlay (beats casual save) → (2) preview render is LOW-RES with watermark BAKED IN (screenshots capture only a branded/blurry, unusable frame) → (3) THE REAL LOCK: the clean full-res master is NEVER SENT to the browser — not in the DOM/network/right-click; generated + served ONLY after UNLOCK via a short-lived SIGNED URL. Do all three → capture is pointless, nothing worth taking. Visual: preview_protection_stack. | 0024_save_the_date/0024_ADDENDUM_envelope_open_experience_2026-06-14.md §7 |
| 2026-06-16 | Save-the-Date · "protect from inspect element" — STANCE (owner request). HONEST: you CANNOT block inspect/DevTools (it's the user's browser); disabling right-click/F12 + devtools-detection are trivially bypassed, hostile to power users, and harm accessibility → DO NOT rely on them (theatre). REFRAME: make inspecting BORING — the page must contain NO secret to find. Guarantees: (1) the served preview <img> IS ALREADY the watermarked LOW-RES derivative (watermark baked into the FILE, not a removable overlay div) → peeling the overlay in DevTools reveals the same watermarked low-res, no clean layer behind it; (2) every media URL is a SHORT-LIVED SIGNED link (session-tied) → copying it from the network tab is useless/expired; (3) the reveal is a <canvas> (no source image to grab; watermark painted into pixels → at most a watermarked screenshot); (4) THE REAL LOCK: clean full-res master is NEVER sent to the browser (not DOM/network/right-click) — generated server-side + served ONLY post-unlock via the signed link. Optional hardeners: FORENSIC watermark (stamp the couple's account-id invisibly → leak traceability) + for the SD VIDEO, encrypted/segmented HLS streaming (no single downloadable .mp4). Extends the preview_protection_stack. | 0024_save_the_date/0024_ADDENDUM_envelope_open_experience_2026-06-14.md §7 |

| 2026-06-16 | **NATIVE APP → PAY ON THE WEBSITE (BDO/GCash, base price) — owner "website is cheaper · website charges via BDO and GCash" (AskUserQuestion: "Send them to the website"). SUPERSEDES the +30% native markup (#1458 CLOSED).** The reality: the app is a Capacitor web-wrapper using the SAME BDO/GCash checkout — there is no IAP in code. So the +30% would have been charged via BDO/GCash in-app = an overcharge (no store cut to cover) AND Apple/Google forbid selling digital goods in-app via an external rail (App Store rejection). RESOLUTION: the app routes payment OUT to the website. `InlineCheckoutDrawer` detects the native shell post-mount (`SetnayanApp` UA, same marker as middleware `isCapacitorClient`) and on native the buy trigger opens the checkout page in the EXTERNAL browser (`window.open(href,'_system')` → Capacitor → Safari/Chrome) instead of the in-app drawer; buyer pays out-of-app via BDO/GCash at the BASE price. Web byte-identical (isNativeApp false outside the WebView). **NET: app & web both = base price** (no markup, no Apple/Google cut, 0% processor via manual BDO/GCash reconciliation); the app is a doorway to web payment. The +30% markup (`lib/platform-pricing.ts`, #1458) is RETIRED. tsc green; native-only (no browser-preview path). **Follow-up flagged:** auth continuity on the external-browser hand-off (separate cookie jar → may need re-login; a one-time deep-link/magic-link smooths it) — do before iOS ships. NO auto-merge (App-Store-policy-sensitive). In `HeroVideoScrub.tsx` the frame is no longer a pure function of scroll position — a delta-time, SPEED-CAPPED rAF loop chases the scroll target: (1) **`MIN_PLAY_SECONDS`=5 + `MAX_RATE`=1/5** caps advance at ≤1/5 progress-per-second → a full play-through ALWAYS takes ≥5s no matter how fast you swipe (keeps gliding at the capped rate after the finger stops; a slow scrub stays under the cap → still tracks scroll 1:1; `EASE_PER_SEC`=6 softens the settle). Robust because `PostHeroReveal` collapses below-hero content to 0 height → a fling LANDS at the hero end + stays pinned, so it finishes on-screen, not scrolled away. (2) **`TRACK_VH` 300→700** = runway for a deliberate slow scrub. Checklist never asks "set your date" as step 1 — it guides: shortlist venues → find the date both share → lock it. The `/find-date` Schedule Matrix is the central mechanism. **(2) Reception venue is the Tier 1 anchor.** It constrains capacity, date window, and budget ceiling more than any other vendor. Shortlisted and deposited BEFORE ceremony venue in both Phase 1 (shortlisting at 480d) and Phase 2 (deposit at 330d). **(3) Three-tier budget model** — Tier 1: `reception_venue` (anchor); Tier 2: the 4 Big (`ceremony_venue`, `catering`, `coordinator`, `photo_video`, ~60–75% of the total budget); Tier 3: the rest of the event-type taxonomy (NOT a hardcoded list — computed from the couple's `interested_categories` picks filtered through the active event type's plan-group tree, minus Tier 1+2; different event types → different Tier 3). **(4) Paperwork is a separate budget line** — `marriage_license`, `psa_cenomar`, `church_fee` (Catholic only), `pre_cana` (Catholic only). Estimated from `ceremony_type` + `region`. **(5) Onboarding pre-fills the checklist.** `estimated_pax` → `guest_estimate` auto-completes; `estimated_budget_centavos` → `set_budget` auto-completes; `interested_categories` seeds the Tier 3 budget scope. Budget task copy reflects this: "Review your budget — Setnayan estimated one from your recommended services." **(6) Adaptive state machine per vendor category:** `not_started → needs_decision → searching → needs_more_options / one_option / in_progress → done` (or `excluded` / `deferred`). Decision prompt: "[Let's look for one] · [Definite No] · [Not sure yet]". Persisted in new `event_category_decisions` table (build queued). **(7) Budget health-check:** `buffer = estimated_budget − (tier1 + tier2 + tier3 + paperwork)`. Buffer ≥ 0 = good; buffer < 0 = show 3 options (increase budget / find cheaper / remove category). **(8) No-results state** — 4 options: Negotiate / Increase budget / Find cheaper / Add from outside + invite to Setnayan. **(9) Negotiation path** — pre-drafted message, sent via the in-app vendor-customer chat thread. One active negotiation per vendor at a time (anti-bombarding rule). All planning actions (negotiation start, budget decisions, lock events) logged in the chat thread as the audit trail. **(10) Budget + guest count moved to Phase 1** (495d/490d, before venue shortlisting at 480d/470d) — you can't evaluate a venue without knowing your headcount or budget. | 2026-06-20 | **Tax-aware pricing floor — STANDING pricing-governance rule (owner: "we should always have the tax-aware pricing floor").** Every priced SKU must clear `price ≥ (cost + target_margin) ÷ (1 − 0.30 − 0.037)`. The stack: **30% income-tax reserve** (conservative planning convention; accountant picks 8%-flat vs graduated) **+ ~3% BIR percentage tax + ~0.5–0.75% LGU business permit/LBT** (both scale with GROSS, the permit renews annually on prior-year sales) ≈ **~3.7% gross levies off the top, then 30% on the rest.** Core principle: **MARGIN = tax-survivability** — high-margin digital SKUs (Papic/monogram/AI/websites ~95–99%) shrug off the stack; low-margin commodity lines (storage/hardware) die (the ~3.7% gross levy alone can exceed the margin; e.g. 1 TB storage @ ₱899 vs ₱855 R2 cost nets ~₱8/mo). Locked consequences: (1) build on high-margin digital SKUs, never a thin-margin commodity line; (2) **storage = baked into the Pro tier, NOT sold** — any upgrade priced near-cost as retention (you can't out-price iCloud's ₱599/2TB = ₱0.29/GB, which is below our ₱0.855/GB wholesale). Supersedes the earlier ₱499–2,499 storage-upgrade ladder sketch. | `Pricing_Collection_2026-06-14.md` §11.A · [[project_setnayan_pricing_admin_managed]] · [[feedback_setnayan_pricing_holistic_review_later]] · [[project_setnayan_marginal_cost_model]] |

| 2026-06-20 | **Repo doc-contract change: per-PR CHANGELOG fragments kill the merge treadmill (owner sign-off requested).** Every feature PR prepended to the top of `CHANGELOG.md` + `STATUS.md`, so any two concurrent PRs conflicted by construction. `.gitattributes` already had `CHANGELOG.md merge=union`, but that only resolves LOCAL merges — **GitHub's auto-merge ignores `.gitattributes` merge drivers**, so in-flight PRs kept flipping to `CONFLICTING` and stalled until hand-merged. Verified the real lever: branch protection is **non-strict** (`required_status_checks.strict=false`), so a merely-*behind* PR auto-merges once green — the ONLY blocker is the `CONFLICTING` state. Fix = news-fragment pattern: each PR writes a unique `changelog.d/<slug>.md` file (can't collide) → PRs go `BEHIND` not `CONFLICTING` → auto-merge fires unattended. Added `changelog.d/` + README + `scripts/changelog-collect.mjs` (folds fragments → CHANGELOG.md at release, no deps), updated repo `CLAUDE.md` doc-contract (feature PRs add a fragment, do NOT edit CHANGELOG.md/STATUS.md directly; STATUS.md = refreshed snapshot, not a per-PR log), kept the union driver as belt-and-suspenders. ⚠ CHANGES HOW EVERY FUTURE SESSION RECORDS CHANGES — surfaced for owner sign-off. The 3 in-flight UX PRs (#1880/#1882/#1885) predate this and still use the old style; the fix applies going forward. | PR `claude/changelog-merge-fix` · `changelog.d/` · `scripts/changelog-collect.mjs` · repo `CLAUDE.md` · `.gitattributes` · [[project_setnayan_merge_workflow_reality]] |

| 2026-06-21 | **Vector Monogram Studio: fixed the PRODUCTION "not loading" race + reduced the page to studio-only (owner "vector studio is not working… make the vector monogram the only screen for the monogram. and make it work" — reported STILL broken on live prod).** Root cause is **production-valid, NOT dev-only StrictMode** (root-caused via a 7-agent parallel workflow + a real `next build`/`next start` repro): the imperative paper.js/opentype.js engine's editor DOM was injected via React `dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{__html: STUDIO_HTML}}`. React's reconciler re-applies that prop whenever its **object reference** changes, and an inline `{{__html}}` literal is a NEW object every render — so the effect's own `setReady(true)` re-render re-set the host's `innerHTML`, re-creating the `#cv`/`#load`/`#names` nodes. The engine's **async font-fetch boot** (mountStudio returns sync; boots in `loadFont('cardo').then`) then fired against the now-DETACHED nodes → hid a detached overlay + drew on a detached canvas (visible overlay stuck on "Loading the typeface…", canvas blank) while the name write landed on the surviving input (real name still showed — the exact reported paradox). The earlier StrictMode/300×150 explanation + 2026-06-19 15s `failTimer` were both incomplete band-aids. **Fix:** the effect now OWNS the editor DOM (`root.innerHTML = STUDIO_HTML` + empty JSX div, wiped on cleanup) in BOTH wrappers, so React never reconciles the subtree. **Engine hardened:** a `destroyed` flag set in `destroy()` bails all async `loadFont` callbacks, closing the unmount-mid-fetch (route-nav-away) race the wrapper fix alone leaves open; + an idempotency guard. **Verified in a real production build** (`/monogram`: overlay hidden, full-res 1032×1360 canvas, monogram painted, interactions repaint). **Product change:** Vector Studio is now the ONLY content of `/dashboard/[eventId]/monogram` — removed the "Upload your own" card, the Feature-Us opt-in, AND the paid "How it animates" upsell (Animated Monogram stays in the Studio add-ons hub); deleted orphaned `upload-card.tsx`. | 2026-06-22 | **STD veil double-audio fixed — iOS-only "video + background music at the same time" on the Save-the-Date (owner-reported on /cale-ice).** The content film keeps the couple's keepsake clip WARM before its beat (unmuted at `volume=0`, looping, invisible) so its audio can crossfade in on the beat. That silencing assumes `volume=0` silences the clip — true on desktop/Android, but **iOS Safari treats `HTMLMediaElement.volume` as read-only** (system volume only): the write is ignored, the getter returns 1, so the warm invisible clip played at FULL volume under the soundtrack the moment the veil lifted. Music-side ducking was fine (it silences by `pause()`, honored on iOS); only the warm clip's volume-0 silence was broken. Regression from the warm-play feature (commit `52ec8ef5`, 2026-06-21) — hence "wasn't an issue before." **Fix (iOS-gated; desktop/Android byte-for-byte unchanged):** new `silenceWarmClip()` helper sets `volume=0`, reads it back, and falls back to `muted=true` where the write didn't stick (iOS); records controllability in `videoVolCtlRef`. Both warm-play sites route through it (warm clip never audible while hidden). The video beat reads the ref: controllable → existing smooth crossfade; not controllable (iOS) → play the clip MUTED, keep the soundtrack as the beat's audio (no dead air), surface the existing "Tap for sound" one-tap fallback. Net: no platform plays clip audio + soundtrack simultaneously. tsc 0 · lint clean · esbuild ok. | 2026-06-23 | **Papic / Alaala memory-economics — OWNER-LOCKED (design decision; ₱ figures ILLUSTRATIVE/PROVISIONAL → holistic pass; build is NET-NEW, not as-built).** Resolved across a long owner working session that stress-tested free Papic from ~8 angles (earn-nothing · exploit · multi-account farm · couple-gets-it-free-via-Drive · pay-everyone's-storage · perpetual-cost-accumulation). **① "Pay to create, free to keep, NO ADS":** Papic CAPTURE/creation (event capture + tagging-at-scale + reveal + SDE) is PAID (high-value, real cost to deliver); the finished CURATED MEMORY — one "post" per event = highlight reel + best ~100–200 photos + story (~1 GB, ~₱25/yr illustrative) — is KEPT FREE FOR LIFE (the emotional moat); **NO ads** (yield ~₱5–20K/mo even at scale + wrecks the private/premium keepsake brand; display ads already retired). Rationale: a one-time event payment (~₱3,000 illus.) CANNOT fund perpetual, accumulating raw storage (~3,000 items ≈ ~30 GB ≈ ~₱300/yr/event → consumes the payment in ~9 yrs then bleeds, compounding per event) — so charge for CREATION, keep only the cheap curated MEMORY. Setnayan = TikTok/Insta-like (each post a memory) but **EVENT-DRIVEN** (one post per event) + **PRIVATE-by-default** → orders-of-magnitude less storage/user → free-for-life is sustainable WITHOUT ads. **② Editorial self-contained in R2; raw firehose Drive-or-Vault:** the curated editorial NEVER links into the couple's Google Drive (moving/deleting Drive files must not break it) — anything curated INTO the editorial is COPIED into R2 (promote raw→editorial). RAW extras live Drive-only (₱0 to Setnayan) OR, if the couple wants Setnayan to host the full raw archive, an OPTIONAL paid annual **Alaala Vault** subscription (recurring cost = recurring fee). REFINES the 2026-06-03 "everything on R2 · Drive = copy" lock → now **R2 = system of record for the CURATED MEMORY (small, durable, free-for-life); RAW firehose = Drive-only (free) or Vault (paid)**, moving the expensive bulk OFF Setnayan's perpetual books. **The free editorial content budget IS the free-storage "limit".** ⚠ NOT AS-BUILT: the shipped free sampler (3 seats / 8 photos + 2 clips / 30-day, [[project_setnayan_papic_free_sampler]]) does NOT implement this split + has a verified storage-leak bug; the curated/raw split + editorial-promote-copy mechanic + Vault are NET-NEW build targets. ⚠ STAGING: Alaala Vault is revamp-derived ([[project_setnayan_alaala_revamp_strategy]] 2026-06-23 staging rule) — this row RECORDS the owner lock; corpus/live-canon integration + build wait for the post-session revamp pass. | DECISION_LOG (this row) · memory [[project_setnayan_storage_drive_copy_architecture]] (2026-06-23 addendum) + [[project_setnayan_papic_free_sampler]] · owner working session 2026-06-23 · ties [[project_setnayan_marginal_cost_model]] [[project_setnayan_pricing_tiers]] |

(2) **No build-skip** → **enabled built-in "Skip deployments when no changes to root dir or its dependencies"** (Turborepo-graph-aware; `turbo-ignore` is deprecated; Ignored Build Step left on Automatic). Amplifier = the parallel multi-agent PR firehose (PRs #2624→#2635 in ~4 hrs, many `claude/*` preview branches, every push rebuilds). **Guardrails going forward:** keep Build Machine Elastic/Standard (never Enhanced/Turbo — Turbo is Turbopack-only, we're on webpack); keep Skip-deployments ON; batch agent pushes; leave Observability Plus ON ($0.35, and disabling it blocks deploys). | 2026-07-03 | **QR-in-media integrity guard (owner-locked): the QR generators are the ONLY free customer-import channel for vendors — and vendors may NOT embed their QR codes in the photos/videos they upload to their website.** Rule as stated: "we will collect all their active QR codes and will check all the photos they upload on their website; if the QR code is there, the photo/video is invalid." Rationale: a vendor who prints their Shortlist/invite QR into portfolio media on `/v/[slug]` turns the marketplace page into a self-serve import funnel — marketplace visitors scan and enter as `source='vendor_invite'` "imports," dodging the inquiry path (burn-to-answer economics) and cheapening the "Verified booking" badge; the QR channel is FOR already-closed off-platform clients, in person. **What "all their active QR codes" means in shipped code:** (1) Shortlist/invite QR = deterministic `buildVendorInviteUrl` → any URL under `/vendor-invite/<their-slug>` (all `et`/`cat` variants — prefix-match, no storage needed); (2) Locked QR = the vendor's active single-use tokens minted by `issueLockedQr` (`lib/vendor-locked-qr` registry). Deliberately scoped to the VENDOR'S OWN codes — real wedding portfolio photos legitimately contain guest/table/event QR codes (Papic is QR-heavy); those must NOT invalidate media. **Enforcement shape (proposed, not yet built):** decode QR from every image upload on vendor-website surfaces (hero, portfolio, service-card showcase photos + the ≤30s clip via frame sampling ~1–2 fps) using a WASM QR decoder; client-side via the #2657 `validateFile` hook for instant feedback + a SERVER-side backstop (client is bypassable); match decoded payload → `/vendor-invite/<slug>` prefix OR active locked-QR token → reject with a clear message; plus a one-time retro-scan of already-uploaded media → admin review queue, not silent deletion. ⚠ Open sign-offs: (a) redirect loophole — exact self-QR matching misses a shortener QR (bit.ly → their invite URL); stricter option = reject ANY decodable QR that resolves to a setnayan.com vendor-invite/claim URL, or ANY QR at all on vendor-website media (recommend at least resolving same-host URLs); (b) "invalid" semantics = reject-at-upload (recommended) vs quarantine-for-admin; (c) whether the guard also covers editorial/moodboard media vendors can surface publicly.
